scope: Invariant positive-metric test on a regular split coadjoint orbit of Spin_0(7,7), independently of functional quantization or a chosen polarization.

theorem.tangent_root_spaces: direct sum of g_alpha over all 84 D7 roots

proof.one_root_argument: If <,> were positive and A-invariant, a nonzero v_alpha would satisfy ||v_alpha||^2=||Ad_exp(H)v_alpha||^2=exp(2 alpha(H))||v_alpha||^2 for every H; regular split roots admit alpha(H) nonzero, a contradiction.
proof.scope_limit: This excludes G-invariant positive tangent metrics on the regular split orbit. It does not exclude noninvariant polarizations, unitary representation constructions, boundary-selected metrics or a separately owned physical Hilbert space.

claim_ceiling: Exact homogeneous-space obstruction to a G-invariant positive metric on the regular split orbit. It is not a no-go for all quantizations, boundary choices or physical positive subspaces.
